verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Jira supports saved searches/JQL queries (a filtered view of work) and that engineers value querying via JQL/REST, but one first-hand account calls creating a useful saved search 'so painful' it feels like sabotage, indicating real usability friction. No first-party documentation explicitly describes saving a filter and sharing it via a shareable link. Missing for 10: official docs on saved-filter creation/sharing workflow, evidence of a direct 'share link' feature, and independent confirmation that sharing works smoothly.
